A real Italian restaurant in the center of Nha Trang
Sep 2026 • Family
I really love Italian cuisine, precisely for such simple dishes. Good fresh products and clear flavors—that's what you need in Vietnam!

I really liked the panzanella with burrata: juicy tomatoes, crispy bread, and creamy burrata.

Minestrone is my love. Such a rich, homemade soup with lots of vegetables, as if grandma cooked it from what was available in the garden.

Ordered a signature pizza with 2 halves. Margarita Bufalina with sweet tomatoes and mozzarella, which pairs perfectly with Aperol Spritz, and Napoli with anchovies and capers. Perfect thin-crust pizza with crispy edges, cooked in a wood-fired oven.

Overindulged again, but it was worth it 😄
We will definitely come back.
